prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native Android UI direction comp
Primary request: Create exactly one polished full-screen MealOS active cooking-mode interface for a Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra unfolded display, 2504×2256 pixels, near-square landscape. Show only the app screenshot edge to edge—no device frame, no bezel, no poster, no presentation board.
Scene/backdrop: One calm pale-stone mise en place prep surface expressed as the app background.
Subject: MealOS cooking “Garlic-herb chicken + baby potatoes + broccoli” in serving mode “Dinner + lunch tomorrow.”
Style/medium: High-fidelity designed native Android product UI, modern Material 3, restrained and adult. Deep green enamel panels, warm cream fields, burnt-orange primary action color, egg-yolk yellow status cues, precise painted measurement marks, and soft tactile silicone controls. Everything visibly in its place.
Composition/framing: Equal-weight two-pane layout organized around the vertical fold/hinge seam. A slim adaptive navigation rail remains clearly visible with four labeled destinations: “Today”, “Plan”, “Recipes”, “Grocery”. Left pane is the current instruction area: “Step 2 of 5”, unmistakable progress, and one large highly readable cooking instruction. Right pane contains scaled ingredients plus two prominent tactile live timers. Preserve balance across the hinge, generous spacing, clear hierarchy, and 48dp minimum touch targets.
Text (verbatim): “MealOS”; “Today”; “Plan”; “Recipes”; “Grocery”; “Garlic-herb chicken + baby potatoes + broccoli”; “Dinner + lunch tomorrow”; “Step 2 of 5”; “Roast the potatoes”; “Toss baby potatoes with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper. Roast until golden and tender.”; “Scaled ingredients”; “Baby potatoes”; “Chicken”; “Broccoli”; “Potatoes”; “12:48”; “Chicken”; “08:20”; “Next step”
Constraints: One coherent operational app screen, not a collage. Native Android visual language. Timers must look active and tactile. Exact timer values 12:48 for potatoes and 08:20 for chicken. Information must remain readable at full-screen view. Make the hinge-aware layout intentional and equal-weight.
Avoid: glossy food-blog photography, generic card grid, device frame or bezel, poster composition, illegible filler, lorem ipsum, invented product claims, marketing slogans, photorealistic food imagery, excessive decoration, tiny controls, iOS styling, floating disconnected widgets, watermarks.
